calendar.title: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your DiveDay departures on the calendar you already use. Subscribing is read-only: DiveDay never reads or changes anything in your calendar.
calendar.refreshNote: Your calendar decides how often it re-reads the feed — usually within a few hours, not instantly. Treat DiveDay as the source of truth for a same-day change.

assignments.name: My departures
assignments.detail: Every trip you are assigned to crew, teach, or captain.

shopTrips.name: All shop departures
shopTrips.detail: Every scheduled departure at this shop, whoever is crewing it.

status.neverRead: No calendar has read it yet — paste the link into one to finish.

actions.confirmRotate: Replace this link? Any calendar still using the old one stops updating.
actions.confirmTurnOff: Turn off this subscription? The link stops working immediately.

newLink.heading: Your subscription link
newLink.shownOnce: Copy this now — for your security it is shown once. If you lose it, replace the link to get a new one.
newLink.webcalHint: Opens your calendar app and subscribes.

warning.rotate: Replacing the link stops the old one working right away. Any calendar still using it will quietly stop updating until you paste the new link in.
warning.shared: Anyone with this link can read these departures without signing in. Treat it like a password.

notice.denied: You do not have access to that calendar scope.

calendar.coverage: Covers departures from {past} days ago through {future} days ahead.

staffing.title: Staffing
staffing.description: See who is working, what each person is qualified to teach or crew, and where the next boat still has a coverage gap.

working.heading: Who is working
working.managerOnly: Shift changes require owner or manager

addShift.heading: Add a working shift
addShift.detail: A shift says when someone is available. Assign the actual crew on each trip separately.

coverage.heading: Coverage gaps
coverage.detail: These are prompts to resolve before the manifest becomes a dock-side surprise.
coverage.noTrips: No scheduled trips in this window.
coverage.allGood: Crew is assigned, and their shift covers this trip.

gap.no_shift_coverage: No working shift covers this trip

notice.overlap: That person already has an overlapping shift.
notice.staffNotFound: That staff member is no longer on this shop's team.
notice.invalid: Check the shift date and times, then try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Only owners and managers can change shifts.

certifications.heading: Certification cards
certifications.description: Evidence starts pending. Look the card number up with the issuing agency, then mark it certified — only certified cards affect readiness.
certifications.empty: No level cards yet — add their first card above so it can make them trip-ready.

card.refresherDueVerify: Refresher due — verify current status with the agency
card.tapToFlipText: Tap the card to flip and view {target}
card.flipAriaLabel: Digital certification card for {level}. Press to flip.

page.title: Divers
page.description: Start with the person. Their cards, rental fit, and bookings stay together so the front desk always has the right context.
page.noticeDuplicate: A diver with that email is already in this shop.
page.noticeDeleted: Diver removed from active shop work. Their bookings and cards are preserved.
page.noticeRestored: Diver restored to active shop work.
page.noticeNotAuthorized: Removing or restoring a diver is limited to owners and managers.
page.noticeInvalid: Check the diver's name, email, and phone number.
page.addDiverBody: Add a returning diver before they book, then fill in the details you already have.

list.onFileShowingText: {total} on file — showing {shown} at a time
list.searchHintText: Search by name, email, or phone.
list.tryDifferentSearch: Try a different search or view, or add a new diver above.
list.addOneHere: Add one here or accept a booking to create their person record.
list.backToTop: ← Back to the top of the list

header.dateOfBirthDescription: Used to check a course's minimum age on the day it runs. Leave it blank and courses book as they always have.

bookActivity.heading: Book an activity
bookActivity.description: Add this diver to an available course or dive, then create the order from their booking.
bookActivity.needEmailWarning: Add an email address before booking. It identifies the diver and is needed to send their order.
bookActivity.noOpenActivities: No open activities are available right now.

payments.heading: Payments
payments.description: Payment status, invoices, and refunds stay with the diver so the next action is easy to find.
payments.noPaymentsYet: No payments yet — they'll appear here once this diver books a trip or you send an invoice.
payments.demoRefundHint: Demo orders aren't backed by a live Stripe invoice, so refunds are disabled here.

remove.heading: Remove from active divers
remove.description: This is a soft delete: the person disappears from active shop lists, while bookings, cards, and rental fit remain intact for records and safety review.
remove.addAgainNote: You can add them again later as a new active record.

rentalFit.heading: Rental fit
rentalFit.description: What this diver takes from the shop, and in what size. It is what the trip prep list is built from — never an equipment reservation or a substitute for a dock-side fit check.
rentalFit.changeRestricted: Changing what this diver asked for is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters. If a size isn't available, flag them for hands-on fitting below.
rentalFit.cantFillHeading: Can't fill one of these sizes?
rentalFit.flaggedBody: Flagged for hands-on fitting — they still count on the prep list, but without a size, and the crew fits them from what's aboard at check-in.
rentalFit.cantFillBody: Flag them for hands-on fitting at check-in. Their count stays on the packing list but the size comes off, so nobody lays out a size the shop is short of — better than quietly substituting one.
rentalFit.fitResolved: Fit resolved — pack their sizes again
rentalFit.clearingRestricted: Clearing this is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters — they confirm the diver can be packed to their stated sizes again.

history.heading: Shop history
history.importedVisitsText: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} came across from your previous system. Those lines are booking records, not dive records — they say what was booked and what your old software called it.
history.noTripsYet: No trips yet — book them onto an open trip and it'll show up here.
history.showOlderEntries: {count, plural, one {Show # older entry} other {Show # older entries}}

specialty.heading: Specialty cards
specialty.description: Specialty cards live with the diver. A verified Nitrox card — confirmed here if it was imported — is required before an EANx fill or tank handoff. An imported card clears the dive or fill it allows once you confirm you've seen it.
specialty.emptyState: No specialty or nitrox cards yet — add one above when they earn it.
specialty.confirmDisclosure: I've seen this diver's card, or checked the number with the issuing agency. Confirming clears {what}.
specialty.whatSpecialtyDive: the {specialty} specialty dive this card allows
specialty.whatNitroxFill: the Nitrox fill this card allows

notices.captured: Card captured as pending. Look the number up with the agency, then mark it certified before it can make this diver ready.
notices.capturedNoPhoto: Card captured as pending. Photo storage isn't set up for this shop, so no photo was attached.
notices.verified: Card marked certified. It now counts toward readiness.
notices.cardDeleted: Card removed. It no longer counts toward readiness; its history is kept for records.
notices.cardRestored: Card restored. It counts toward readiness again.
notices.cardRestoreConflict: Couldn't restore that card — another card now uses its number. Re-add it if you still need it.
notices.fitFlagged: Flagged for hands-on fitting. The prep list will show this diver needs staff sizing at check-in.
notices.fitCleared: Fit flag cleared — this diver packs from their stated sizes again.
notices.image: That photo could not be used. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP under 5 MB.
notices.duplicate: Another diver already uses that email in this shop.
notices.refunded: Payment refunded — the trip now shows as unpaid for this diver.
notices.booked: Activity booked. Review it below, then create and send the invoice.
notices.tripFull: That activity just filled up. Choose another.
notices.alreadyBooked: This diver is already booked on that activity.
notices.courseUnstaffed: Assign an instructor before booking this course.
notices.coursePrerequisite: Mark the required certification as certified before booking this course.
notices.courseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit. Assign another instructor or certified assistant, or choose another activity.
notices.courseMinAge: This diver is under that course's minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on file. Correct the date of birth if it's wrong.
notices.tripUnavailable: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.bookingInvalid: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.refundFailed: That payment could not be refunded. It may not be paid, or Stripe may need attention.
notices.demoDisabled: This is a demo order — it isn't backed by a live Stripe invoice, so it can't be refunded.
notices.deleted: Diver removed from active shop work. Their bookings and cards are preserved.
notices.notAuthorizedRefund: Refunds are limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to issue this refund.
notices.notAuthorizedDelete: Removing a diver is limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to do it.
notices.notAuthorizedFit: Changing a diver's stated rental fit is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters. You can still flag them for hands-on fitting at check-in.
notices.cardSightingRequired: Confirming an imported card needs the checkbox: it opens the dive or the fill that card allows, so a staffer has to say they've actually seen it or checked the number with the agency.
notices.invalid: Check the details and try again.

list.title: Courses
list.description: Your shop copy of the PADI and SSI catalog. Open a course to edit its page and pricing, or hide the ones you don't offer.

edit.description: Everything a diver reads before booking — the copy, the photos, and your pricing. The certification and minimum age come from the agency.
edit.hiddenFromDivers: Hidden from divers and the session picker.
edit.noticeShown: Course page live. Divers can read it and book a session.
edit.noticeHidden: Course page hidden. Scheduled sessions are unchanged.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the fields and try again.
edit.errorImages: You can keep up to eight gallery photos. Remove one before adding more.
edit.errorUpload: That photo didn't upload. Try a JPG, PNG, or WebP under 5 MB.
edit.errorTooManyPhotos: Add up to {max} new gallery photos per save. Save this batch, then add more.
edit.subheadDescription: One line under the title, e.g. “How to become a PADI Open Water Diver”.
edit.overviewDescription: A few paragraphs in the diver's words, not the agency's.
edit.pricingDescription: Two lines on one bill: your instruction fee and the agency's e-learning fee. The diver pays the total in a single payment.
edit.photosDescription: Upload your own photos. New files are added to the gallery; tick a photo to remove it.
edit.galleryPhotosHint: (up to eight in total, {max} new per save)
edit.glanceDescription: The chips across the top of the page — how the course runs. Who may take it is the next box.
edit.enrollDescription: The one block on the page that answers “can I do this?”. The certification and minimum age come from the agency: {levelAge} — shown here automatically and not editable. Your note appears under them, labelled as the shop talking, so it never reads as replacing the card the desk checks.
edit.includedPlaceholder:
6 open water dives
Full rental gear
Light lunch
edit.dayByDayDescription: One card per day: a title, real start/end times when the day runs on a fixed clock (or a free-text note when it doesn't, like "week 1–2"), and what happens.
edit.faqDescription: One block per question, separated by a blank line. First line is the question, the rest is the answer.
edit.faqPlaceholder:
Is equipment included?
Yes — mask, fins, wetsuit, BCD, regulator, and tanks.

Do I need to be a strong swimmer?
You need to be comfortable in the water.

dayByDay.timeNoteDescription: For a day with no fixed clock time, e.g. "week 1–2" or "about 3 hours". Ignored when start time is set.

pathBuilder.noSteps: No courses on this path yet. Add the first one a diver would take, then build upward.
pathBuilder.courseGoneFromCatalog: Course no longer in the catalog
pathBuilder.stepNotePlaceholder: Most divers wait a season before this one
pathBuilder.atCapDescription: A path holds up to {max} courses.
pathBuilder.notOnPathDescription: Only courses that aren't already on this path are listed.
pathBuilder.allCoursesOnPath: Every course in your catalog is already on this path.
pathBuilder.addACourseToSee: Add a course to see the progression.

pathEdit.errorInvalid: That didn't save — give the path a name and try again.
pathEdit.errorDuplicate: You already have a path with that name.
pathEdit.errorNotAuthorized: Building paths is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
pathEdit.description: Drop courses in the order a diver would take them. Nothing here decides who may enrol — that stays with each course's own certification requirement.
pathEdit.oneHiddenStep: {course} is hidden in your catalog, so divers won't be shown that step.
pathEdit.manyHiddenSteps: {count} courses on this path are hidden in your catalog, so divers won't be shown those steps.
pathEdit.summaryPlaceholder: Three courses and a season of diving between them.
pathEdit.hiddenPathsNote: Hidden paths stay here for you and never suggest a next course.
pathEdit.notAuthorizedNotice: Building paths is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.

pathsList.errorInvalid: That didn't save — give the path a name and try again.
pathsList.errorDuplicate: You already have a path with that name.
pathsList.errorNotAuthorized: Building paths is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
pathsList.title: Certification paths
pathsList.description: The order you'd walk a diver through your courses. A path is guidance, not a gate — it never changes who may enrol in anything.
pathsList.noPathsBody: Most shops start with the one every diver asks about: Open Water, then Advanced, then Rescue.
pathsList.noCoursesYet: No courses on this path yet.
pathsList.startNewPathBody: Name it the way a diver would ask for it. You'll add the courses next.
pathsList.pathNamePlaceholder: From first breath to Rescue Diver
pathsList.summaryPlaceholder: Three courses and a season of diving between them.
pathsList.notAuthorizedNotice: Building paths is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.

list.title: Dive-site library
list.description: Build the briefing once, then attach it to any trip. Copy a site before tailoring a special itinerary.
list.siteArchivedNotice: Site archived. Historical trip briefings are still preserved.
list.emptyHeading: Start with a site your crew knows well
list.emptyBody: Add a location, a map or route image, and the life divers may encounter.
list.templateUpdateReady: Template update v{version} ready — your edits are safe.
list.addBriefingFallback: Add the briefing your divers will see.

catalog.title: DiveDay common dive sites
catalog.description: Published, versioned starting points. Importing makes an independent shop briefing; later template updates never overwrite your edits.

form.forecastDescription: Use the offshore dive point, not the shop address. Leave both blank to keep crew-only conditions.
form.divePlanPlaceholder: Entry, route, turnaround, and exit notes.
form.noLevelRequired: No level required by the site
form.errorImages: One of those image links couldn't be used — use up to six complete HTTP(S) links, one per line, each pointing to a real, reachable image.
form.errorImagesUnconfigured: Image hosting isn't set up for this shop yet — leave the image links blank for now, or ask your shop's owner or manager to configure it.

edit.description: Changes update the briefing linked to this site.
edit.archiveConfirmBody: Historical trips keep their briefing; new trips will no longer see this site.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the name and links, then try again.
edit.certificationDescription: What this site itself demands. Every trip that visits enforces at least this — when the trip asks for more, the stricter rule wins.

new.title: Build a dive-site briefing
new.description: Everything is optional except the name. Keep it useful, vivid, and true to the site.
new.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the required name and links, then try again.
new.certificationDescription: These requirements travel with the site into every new trip that uses it.

notices.cancelled: Trip cancelled — it's off the public schedule.
notices.reinstated: Back on! The trip is on the schedule again.
notices.crewConflict: Crew wasn't changed — someone is already assigned during this time, or the course would fall below its teaching ratio.
notices.bookingRemoved: Booking cancelled — the spot is open again.
notices.bookingRemovedRefunded: Booking cancelled and the payment refunded — the spot is open again.
notices.bookingRemovedForfeit: Booking cancelled — the spot is open again. It was past the cancellation window, so the seat was non-refundable.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundManual: Booking cancelled — a refund is owed but must be issued by hand (counter payment, or Stripe isn't connected). Refund from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundFailed: Booking cancelled, but the automatic refund didn't go through — issue it from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundReview: Booking cancelled. The payment record and Stripe disagree on what was captured — review the diver's payments before issuing any refund.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundOwner: Booking cancelled and the spot is open. This booking was paid, so a refund may be owed — an owner or manager needs to issue it from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRestoreFull: Couldn't undo — the freed spot has been taken and the trip is full again. Add them to the wait list instead.
notices.diverWaitlisted: Diver added to the wait list.
notices.identityConfirmed: Identity confirmed — this diver can be cleared to board.
notices.diverInvalid: Enter a name and a valid email to add a diver.
notices.diverFull: That trip is full — add them to the wait list instead.
notices.diverWaitlistAvailable: There's room on this trip — add them to the trip instead of the wait list.
notices.diverAlready: That diver already has a booking on this trip.
notices.diverCourseUnstaffed: This course session needs an instructor assigned before you can add divers.
notices.diverCoursePrerequisite: That diver doesn't have a verified certification on file for this course's prerequisite.
notices.diverCourseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit — assign another instructor or a certified assistant, or add them to the wait list.
notices.diverCourseMinAge: That diver is under this course's minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on their profile. Correct the date if it's wrong.
notices.diverUnavailable: This trip can't accept new divers right now.
notices.waiverComplete: That diver already has a completed waiver.
notices.waiverInPerson: Paper waiver recorded — the diver's release is on file.
notices.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver — or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notices.waiverError: That waiver link could not be created. Try a current booking and template.
notices.bulkWaiver: Waiver links sent to the selected divers who still needed one — anyone already signed was left alone.
notices.bulkWaiverNone: Tick at least one diver, then send the waiver to the whole selection.
notices.seriesApplied: Those details now apply to every upcoming date in this series.
notices.seriesAppliedPartial: Applied to the upcoming dates in this series. A few already had more divers than the new capacity, or already had a roll call recorded past the new dive count, so those were left as they were — adjust them from their own trip pages.
notices.seriesCancelled: Cancelled every upcoming date in this series. Reinstate any single date from its own trip page.
notices.seriesExtended: Added more dates — the series runs further out on the board now.
notices.seriesError: That series change didn't go through. Try again from a scheduled date in the series.
notices.recapNote: Recap note saved — it rides along on every diver's recap once this trip departs.
notices.conditions: Crew prediction published — divers will see it now.
notices.conditionsCleared: Crew prediction cleared. Divers will see the automated outlook when it is available.
notices.notAuthorized: You don't have permission to change this trip's setup. Trip configuration is limited to owners, managers, and instructors — ask one of them to make this change.
notices.invalid: That didn't save — check the date, times, and capacity, then try again.
notices.endBeforeStart: The trip has to end after it starts.
notices.capacityBelowBooked: That capacity is below how many divers are already booked on this trip — cancel bookings first, or set a higher capacity.
notices.capacityBelowBookedCount: {count, plural, one {That capacity is below the # diver already booked on this trip — cancel bookings first, or set a higher capacity.} other {That capacity is below the # divers already booked on this trip — cancel bookings first, or set a higher capacity.}}
notices.lastMinuteSentCount: {count, plural, one {Last-minute deal sent to # diver.} other {Last-minute deal sent to # divers.}}
notices.lastMinuteTripUnavailable: This trip isn't open for a last-minute deal — it's past, cancelled, or already departed.
notices.lastMinuteTripFull: This trip is already full — there's nothing to fill.
notices.lastMinuteNotConnected: Connect Stripe in Settings before sending a last-minute deal — the discount code needs a connected account to exist on.
notices.lastMinuteNoRecipients: No one on the last-minute list is around for this trip's date yet.
notices.lastMinuteStripeFailed: Stripe couldn't create the discount code. Try again in a moment.
notices.plannedDivesBelowHistory: Can't drop the dive count below one staff already recorded a roll call against — that history has to stay reachable.
notices.plannedDivesBelowHistoryCount: Can't drop the dive count below {count} — staff already recorded a roll call after dive {count} on this trip, and that history has to stay reachable.

detail.meetingDaysSummary: {count} meeting days · same instructors each day
detail.seriesPart: Part of a repeating series · {summary}. Changes here apply to this date only; {count} still on the schedule.
detail.viewOnlyNotice: You're viewing this trip. Its setup — the details, admission requirements, and recurring schedule — is edited by owners, managers, and instructors. Recording conditions, adjusting who's on crew, and cancelling today's trip for weather stay open to you, as do the roster, check-in, manifest, and roll call.
detail.overRatioWarning: {booked} divers are booked, but the current crew only covers {cap} under PADI's published entry-level ratio (8 per instructor, +2 per certified assistant). Assign another instructor or a certified assistant before this session sails — existing bookings are unaffected either way.
detail.cancelledNotice: This trip is cancelled. Putting it back on the schedule is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
detail.cancelHint: Takes it off the public schedule and notifies booked divers.

details.heading: Details
details.payAtBookingDescription: Optional. Leave the deposit blank to charge the full fare when a diver books online.
details.depositDescription: Charged now; the balance is still owed at the dock. Ignored if it's blank or not below the price. Many shops set 20–30% of the fare.
details.cancellationWindowDescription: Hours before departure a diver can cancel for a refund. Shown to divers; refunds stay staff-run. 48 hours is a common window.

conditions.heading: Crew prediction
conditions.description: Publish the crew’s read on the day. It replaces the automated marine outlook for divers.
conditions.holdDescription: Pause new bookings, publish the final-call state, and email booked divers when delivery is configured.
conditions.overviewPlaceholder: A calm morning is expected; the crew will confirm the final call at the dock.

crew.heading: Crew
crew.courseNeedsInstructor: This course cannot take bookings until one assigned crew member has the instructor role.
crew.noCrew: No crew to assign yet — your instructors and divemasters show up here once they’re on the team.

recapNote.heading: Post-trip recap note
recapNote.description: A short shout-out from the crew, shown on every diver's recap after this trip departs. Leave it blank to send none.
recapNote.placeholder: Killer vis today — thanks for diving with us. Come back for the wreck next month!

requirements.heading: Readiness requirements
requirements.courseDescription: This session keeps the admission rules it was created with — editing the course later won’t change what enrolled students need.
requirements.tripDescription: These are the trip’s rules. A diver stays blocked until every one of them checks out.
requirements.requiredSpecialtiesDescription: A diver is blocked until a verified card for each proves the specialty.
requirements.siteAlsoRequires: {site} also requires {list}. Readiness always enforces the stricter of the site and this trip.

series.heading: Repeating series
series.summaryWithFuture: {summary} · {count, plural, one {# upcoming date still on the board.} other {# upcoming dates still on the board.}}
series.summaryAllDone: {summary} · every date has departed or been cancelled.
series.applyToSeries: Apply this date's details to the whole series
series.applyDescription: Copies this date's title, description, capacity, pricing, and dive plan onto every upcoming date. Each date's own time, crew, roster, and conditions stay put; a date already carrying more divers than the new capacity is left alone.
series.addMoreDatesAriaLabel: How many more dates to add
series.extendDescription: Rolls the series forward on the same cadence, starting the week after its last date. New dates inherit the latest date's details.
series.cancelDescription: {count, plural, one {Takes the remaining # date off the public schedule.} other {Takes the remaining # dates off the public schedule.}} Reinstate any single date from its own trip page.

recapPhotos.heading: Diver photos
recapPhotos.description: Shared by divers on their own recap pages. Grab any for the shop, or remove one that shouldn't be up.
recapPhotos.confirmRemove: Remove this photo from the diver's recap?

addDiver.heading: Add a diver
addDiver.fullDescription: The boat is full — hand-entered divers go straight onto the wait list, no public booking page required.
addDiver.searchDescription: Search a returning diver to add them in one tap — their cards, waivers, and rental fit come along. New to the shop? Enter them by hand below.
addDiver.noRentalFitYet: No rental fit on file yet
addDiver.noMatches: No returning diver matches “{query}”. Enter them by hand below.
addDiver.handEntrySummary: New to the shop? Enter a diver by hand
addDiver.handEntryDescriptionWaitlist: For walk-ins or divers tracked in another system — puts them straight on the wait list.
addDiver.handEntryDescriptionManifest: For walk-ins or divers tracked in another system — puts them straight on the manifest.

waitlist.heading: Wait list
waitlist.description: These divers have not booked a seat and do not appear on the manifest. When one opens up, invite the next in line — one tap emails them the booking link.
waitlist.empty: No one’s waiting yet — when the trip sells out, divers can join the wait list from the public trip page.
waitlist.emailBody:
Hi {firstName},

A seat just opened on {tripTitle} ({tripWhen}) with {shopName}. You're next on the wait list — grab it here before it goes:
{bookingUrl}

See you on the boat!

lastMinute.heading: Last-minute deal
lastMinute.description: Every empty seat on a boat that's already sailing is money lost. Push a time-boxed discount to divers who said they're around — it expires at departure or once seats run out, whichever comes first.
lastMinute.sendTo: {count, plural, one {Send to # diver} other {Send to # divers}}
lastMinute.fullNotice: This trip is full — there's nothing to fill.
lastMinute.noneAroundNotice: No one on the last-minute list is around for this date yet.
lastMinute.sentTo: {count, plural, one {Sent {date} to # diver} other {Sent {date} to # divers}}

roster.heading: Divers
roster.noBookings: No bookings yet — share the trip page and they'll show up here.
roster.confirmIdentityMessage: Confirm this booking really is {name}? Only do this once you’ve checked it’s the same person — not someone else sharing the email.
roster.confirmResendWaiver: Send {name} a new waiver link? Their previous link will stop working.
roster.medicalAttestationLabel: I have this diver's signed release on file and have reviewed their medical questionnaire — no answer needs physician sign-off.
roster.signedPaper: Signed {date} · recorded from a paper copy
roster.signedImported: Signed {date} · imported from a prior shop
roster.medicalFollowUpDescription: A diver answered yes to a medical question. Confirm physician clearance before boarding.
roster.nitroxApproved: Nitrox requested — verified card, billed per dive. The mix is still analyzed and signed for at the fill station.
roster.nitroxUnverified: Nitrox requested, but no verified card. Planned as air.
roster.confirmRemoveBooking: Remove {name} from this trip? If they're eligible for a refund, it's issued automatically.
roster.addNoteLabel: Add a note only staff can see

manifest.description: The authoritative roster: everyone aboard — divers and crew — with emergency contacts, at every checkpoint. Board the ready divers on Before departure, then run roll call again after each dive.
manifest.liveManifestBadge: Live manifest · save an offline copy below
manifest.allAccountedFor: Everyone’s accounted for — ready for the next check.
manifest.stillToCall: {count, plural, one {# diver still to call.} other {# divers still to call.}}
manifest.blockedDeparture: {count, plural, one {# diver is blocked. They remain on this manifest and cannot board until their readiness check clears.} other {# divers are blocked. They remain on this manifest and cannot board until their readiness check clears.}}
manifest.blockedAfterDive: {count, plural, one {# diver is blocked. They already sailed — record whoever is aboard. Their readiness is a paperwork flag to follow up on shore, not a bar to this head count.} other {# divers are blocked. They already sailed — record whoever is aboard. Their readiness is a paperwork flag to follow up on shore, not a bar to this head count.}}
manifest.noCrew: No crew on this trip yet — assign instructors and crew from the trip page.
manifest.checkEachDiverDescription: Check each diver at this checkpoint. Every change is time-stamped with the staff member who made it.
manifest.medicalClearanceImported: Medical clearance imported — not reviewed here
manifest.addNoteSummary: Add a note to this roll-call record
manifest.carriedForward: Carried forward — not boarded on an earlier checkpoint. Mark boarded to bring them back on.
manifest.tapToUndo: Tap the ✓ status again to undo.

rollCall.errorRefusal: That didn’t save. Recheck your connection or tap again.
rollCall.stillBlocked: Diver is still blocked. <guestsLink>Open Guests to resolve the blocker</guestsLink>, then try again.

prep.crewCount: {count, plural, one {# diving crew member} other {# diving crew}}
prep.oneTankPerDiver: one tank per diver per dive
prep.noDivers: No divers booked yet — nothing to prepare.
prep.includesCrew: {count, plural, one {Includes the roster and the divemaster or instructor assigned to this trip; spares are not counted.} other {Includes the roster and the divemasters and instructors assigned to this trip; spares are not counted.}}
prep.diversOnlyNote: Divers on the roster only — spares are not counted. Assign a divemaster or instructor to this trip to include their tanks.
prep.noGasAnalysisNote: DiveDay logs no gas analysis: every mix is still analyzed and signed for at the fill station.
prep.nitroxBlockedHeading: Nitrox requested without a verified card
prep.nitroxBlockedDescription: Planned as air. Verify the Nitrox card on the diver’s record, or tell them at the counter before the boat leaves.
prep.noFitDescription: They may be bringing their own kit — but nobody has asked. Their sizes are missing from the list below.
prep.staffFitDescription: A size they asked for wasn’t available. They still count on the list below, but without a size — start from what they asked for, bring a range around it, and fit them in person rather than packing a substitute.
prep.noSizesOnFile: — no sizes on file to start from
prep.nothingToPullNeedsSorting: Nothing to pull from the fits on file — but the divers listed above still need sorting out.
prep.nothingToPullOwnKit: Nothing to pull — every diver on this trip brings their own kit.

guests.waiverLinkDescription: Share this link with the diver. It expires in seven days and is replaced if you issue a new one.
guests.demandHeading: This departure could support more capacity

new.errorInvalid: That didn't save — check the date, times, and capacity, then try again.
new.errorEndBeforeStart: The trip has to end after it starts — check the times.
new.errorNotAuthorized: Scheduling and editing trips is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
new.title: Schedule a trip or course session
new.description: Times are local to the shop. Course sessions inherit their admission rules when you put them on the board.
new.viewOnlyNotice: Scheduling and editing trips is limited to owners, managers, and instructors. The crew runs the day on the water — the roster, check-in, manifest, and roll call — from each trip's own page.
new.courseDescription: {requirement} · add an instructor before sharing the session
new.descriptionPlaceholder: Sites, conditions, who it's for, required certs.
new.priceDescription: Pre-fills the trip fee when staff invoice a diver from this trip's roster.
new.payAtBookingDescription: Optional. When the trip is priced and the shop takes card payments, divers pay online as they book. Leave the deposit blank to charge the full fare up front.
new.depositDescription: Charged now; the balance is still owed at the dock. Ignored if it's blank or not below the price. Many shops set 20–30% of the fare.
new.cancellationWindowDescription: Hours before departure a diver can cancel for a refund. Shown to divers; refunds stay staff-run. 48 hours is a common window.
new.repeatDescription: Put the same trip on the board for several weeks at once. Each date is created as its own trip — book, crew, and edit them one at a time.
new.numberOfTripsDescription: Up to {max}, counting the first. Ignored when it doesn't repeat.
